aggregate_grouping_field_shared_by_sets.note: A field grouped on by both sets is one output column, not two.

aggregate_grouping_sets_declared_order.note: The aggregate declares field 2 before field 0; the declared order is the output order.

ctas_keeps_declared_schema.note: A CTAS declares the schema of the table it creates; it is not the schema of its input.

virtual_table_emit_mapping.note: A virtual table carrying an emit mapping returns only the columns the mapping names.
